claim: Using a dynamic, self-updating library compiled from decomposed sub-tasks enhances reasoning performance in scientific problem-solving.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by comparing reasoning performance of agents using a dynamic self-updating library versus a static knowledge base on scientific benchmarks.

conditions: Knowledge integration tasks in scientific domains
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, population, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Dynamic, self-updating library compiled for Reasoning performance
